d:
The Lakers defeated the Heat, 138-117 tonight in Los Angeles. Luka Dončić contributed a team-high 42 points to go with 13 assists 7 rebounds and 6 three pointers, with Austin Reaves of the Lakers adding an additional 27 points (10-15 FG, 4-5 3P). Giannis Antetokounmpo finished with a team-high 30 points along with 12 rebounds for the Heat in the losing effort. The Lakers improve their record to 6-2 with the win, while the Heat fall to 2-5 for the season.
